text:
irina: heads-up — planning a 23:00 UTC kernel swap to `runtime-kernel@v3.2-quant2` across eu/na regions. rolling canary 1% -> 5% -> 20%. need final thumbs and smoke checklist.

deploy-bot: scheduled swap at 2025-06-15T23:00:00Z. canary slices: na-eu: 1% (00-15), 5% (15-45), 20% (45-90). Auto-fallback enabled.

mike: noted. i'm on nightshift, can run smoke after 5% and 20% passes. where's the smoke playbook link?

sara: smoke playbook: https://wiki.redwood/smoke/runtime-kernel-swap — please run `smoke latency` + `smoke correctness` on sample set `core_prompts_v2`.

ben: Q: customers on Dedicated with pinned versions — do we auto-bypass them?

irina: dedicated won't be moved. routing policy `customer.pin==true` -> keep old runtime. we need to update release notes to call out pin override.

qa-bot: preflight checks: build artifact signed ✅, quant artifacts checksum mismatch check ✅, perf regression quick-run: 3/5 tests flaky (see logs) — retry suggested.

mike: i reran the perf quick-run, failures were noise due to host jitter. will run 10x to be safe.

sara: rollback criteria draft: 1) 5% latency p95 regression > 30ms sustained for 10m, 2) error rate increase > 0.5% absolute, 3) KV cache miss spike > 3x baseline. if any triggered, immediate traffic revert to previous kernel for affected region.

ben: add: model output divergence alert: RERUN eval set and if sacreBLEU-like score drop > 1.5 absolute -> rollback.

irina: agreed. also add: if canary fails in eu but na clean — we isolate region and hold na progression.

deploy-bot: note: sticky-pin TTL set to 1h for emergency reverts. Command to pin: `deploybot pin --target region=eu kernel=prev --ttl 1h`.

mike: i'll prepare release note blurb: short summary + impact table + rollback steps. posting PR in 20m.

sara: last call: anyone planning infra changes in next 2h? @ops

ops: i'm pausing the nightly autoscaler job for the window. will unpause after 2h.

irina: thanks. plan looks good. final go/no-go 22:45 UTC. @mike @sara please ping in thread when done with preflight runs. :thumbsup:
